title: adhatoda sphaerosperma
intro: Adhatoda sphaerosperma, commonly known as Vasa or Adhatoda, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of India and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its various health benefits, including the relief of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its use as a natural remedy for fever and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda sphaerosperma include expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its ability to relieve coughs and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and volatile oils, including adhatodasin and vasicinone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
